title: Gala Travels
subtitle: Flight, Hotel, Vacation & Cruise Booking
description: Gala Travels – Travel Agency Booking Platform
A travel-agency platform for booking flights, hotels, vacations, and cruises (galatravels.com).
Frontend built with Vue/Nuxt, with a Laravel backend powering booking flows.
Interactive booking forms, listings, and itinerary views designed to stay simple for agents and travelers.
The site adapts to mobile and desktop, handling booking data without friction.
Kept visuals consistent with the brand and the interface approachable.
